User Journey: Appraisal Management - Appraisal to Vehicle and Asset Lending funding journey
Business Process:
1. Locked Appraisal on a Trade-in Opportunity hands off appraised value + payoff to F&I
2. Vehicle and Asset Lending creates Financial Account for the new vehicle, capturing rolled trade allowance, payoff, and any negative-equity delta

5. Funding posts -> trade Asset transferred to dealer ownership; new Asset created for sold vehicle; Asset Title workflow opens
6. Late-stage deal unwind reverses Financial Account, releases Appraisal back to Reopened, restores trade Asset ownership

User Journey: Appraisal Management - Appraisal Outbound Event publish journey (Platform Event / CDC contract)
Business Process:
1. Appraisal lock transition fires Salesforce Platform Event (or Change Data Capture event) carrying the canonical appraisal payload
2. Subscribers (DMS connector, OEM portal, data lake, Data Cloud activation, etc.) consume the event externally; Salesforce only owns the publish surface
3. Lock-state immutability is enforced - subsequent edits to a locked Appraisal must not republish stale data; only explicit Reopen / Adjust events allowed
4. Republish on subscriber failure follows Platform Event replay rules (last 72 hrs replay window) - Salesforce does not implement custom outbox / retry; that belongs to the consumer
